title: TRIMS: Trajectory-Ranked Instruction Masked Supervision for Diffusion Language Models
selection_reason: The primary full text confirms TRIMS is an inference-time decoding method that improves parallelism and token throughput while retaining similar accuracy; the training data curation is much cheaper than distillation but is not the basis for this classification. Body review: TRIMS is presented as low-latency DLM inference and raises parallelism/TPS up to about 3× with similar accuracy. The paper also reports 0.6 GPU-hours curation versus 287 GPU-hours distillation; this training-side comparison is separate from the inference contribution.
